car.model: Kia Sorento Plug-in Hybrid or similar
car.spec: Kia Sorento PHEV or similar · automatic · 4x4 · 5 doors · 5 seats · 4 large bags · 23+ only · unlimited mileage

pickup.place: Keflavík Intl Airport — Hertz counter in the ARRIVALS HALL, just after customs

restrictions.summary: The signed declaration bans PLUG-IN HYBRID, electric, luxury and 2WD vehicles from F-roads and three named roads — even though ours is a 4x4. Breach = 150,000 ISK fee under Article 10, plus the damage is uninsured.
bannedRoads: Any road marked F on official maps
restrictions.note: This is a USE restriction, not an insurance option — MAX coverage does not lift it. It is also largely moot in October: the highland roads are shut for the season and our route was audited leg by leg and contains none of them.
restrictions.routeVerified: All 40 legs re-checked against the contract ban list. No F-road, no 550 Kaldidalur, no 208 Landmannalaugar. Road 35 is used on Oct 10 for the Golden Circle — that is the PAVED Biskupstungnabraut south of Gullfoss, which is not the banned Kjolur. The route's northernmost point on 35 is 64.3289, about 200 m past the falls (the car park exit, which OSM labels Kjalvegur); the highland Kjolur track begins around 64.36 and we never reach it.
